usedFor: Locate2u holds trips, stops and shipments, and HubSpot holds the contacts that “Update Contact” keeps current.

bestTemplate.name: “Shipment Status Change” in Locate2u, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A shipment status change updates the customer's HubSpot contact, so sales sees where a delivery stands.

watchOut: “Update Contact” works by email and only updates an existing contact, so unknown recipients are not created.
